name: Dark Frenzy reduces global cooldowns while a Cursed Form is active (#1328)
contract: Dark Frenzy 704644 effect 0 is Effect 65 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 2 / DieSides 1 (3%) - the first tooltip clause, fully native and asserted here as a regression. The second clause, 'while a Cursed Form is active, your global cooldowns are reduced by $804845s3%', takes its number from 804845 effect 2: aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 21 (SPELLMOD_GLOBAL_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -26 / DieSides 1, i.e. -25%, with an all-ones class mask inside SpellFamilyName 26. The only Spell.dbc row that triggers 804845 is 804699 'Cursed Form', and coa-obtainable --class 20 (222/222 identical between the shipped CharacterAdvancement.dbc and the live-client capture) reports advancement=none and live_capture=False for both 804699 and 804845, so the clause never applied. 562572 Accursed Form is one of the five Cursed Form shapes the module already tracks. spell_modifier applies the player's live modifiers for a SpellModOp to a supplied base without submitting a cast.

steps.label: No global cooldown modifier before the talent
The raid haste aura is present (regression)
The raid haste effect resolves to 3% (regression)
Out of form the talent leaves global cooldowns alone
Out of form the in-form modifier is absent
Entering a Cursed Form applies Dark Frenzy's in-form modifier
Leaving the form drops the modifier
